item.title: Future of DevOps in the AI World
item.description: If you have been doing DevOps long enough, you remember the shift from artisanal deploys to pipeline-as-code. The next shift will feel familiar in shape even if the ingredients look alien: we are still wiring stages, gates, and blast radius—but some stages will call models and tools, not only make and kubectl.

item.title: AI IDE Fundamentals: Agents, Commands, Skills, Rules, Context, and Workflows Explained
item.description: Modern AI-powered IDEs like Kilo Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and GitHub Copilot have introduced a new vocabulary: agents, skills, rules, contexts, and workflows. But what do these terms actually mean, and how do you use them effectively?
